turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to svc324 while multiple other services over the same S10–S21 lightpath remain healthy, and all line-interface, channel, amplifier, OSNR, power, BER, DGD, and SOP measurements show no change. This rules strongly against a shared optical-path fault. The coincident EQPT_PORT_FAIL specifically at the S21 client port identifies that port as the cause; CLIENT_SF at both ends is consistent with the resulting service interruption.

proposals.rationale: O3 explicitly reports EQPT_PORT_FAIL at this port at onset. Only svc324 is down, while other services sharing the lightpath are healthy and optical-path instrumentation is unchanged.
A failure of the opposite client port could also interrupt only svc324 and produce client signal-fail indications, but there is no EQPT_PORT_FAIL at S10; the equipment failure alarm is at S21.
